title: Diamond Remix
description: Adds a Diamond Upgrade between Iron and Diamond tools to Progression Reborn, to slow the progression to diamond down a bit more. Also includes compability with Copper Age Backport and Backported Spears, but only if they're installed.
body:
This mod mainly exists for a modpack I'm working on that may or may not end up uploaded to Modrinth...

This mod mainly adds a new Diamond Upgrade Smithing Template, that you need to upgrade Iron tools to Diamond ones in the Smithing Table. It's meant to be used alongside [Progression Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/progression-reborn) to make the one tool you make as Copper stay with you through to Netherite; both to slow down the upgrade progression, and also to let you get more attached to your individual tools.

This mod also has some compatability stuff for Progression Reborn:

[Copper Age Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/backport-copper-age): Lets you use the Copper Age Backport copper tools to upgrade to Iron instead of the ones added by Progression Reborn.
[Backported Spears](https://modrinth.com/mod/backported-spears): Backports the Rose Spear from future versions of Progression Reborn, alongside changing the handle on the Iron Spear to match the other iron tools.
